fields.label: Run name
fields.description: Name of the imported GROMACS run, derived from its folder.

fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: Workflow inferred from the integrator and temperature or pressure coupling settings.

fields.label: Engine version
fields.description: GROMACS version reported by a log or output file.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Method inferred from the GROMACS integrator setting.

fields.label: Force field
fields.description: Force-field include files found in GROMACS topology text.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: First reference temperature from ref_t, expressed in kelvin.

fields.label: Pressure coupling
fields.description: Whether pressure coupling is enabled through pcoupl.

fields.label: Pressure
fields.description: First reference pressure from ref_p, expressed in bar.

fields.label: Time step
fields.description: GROMACS integration timestep from dt, expressed in picoseconds.

fields.label: Total steps
fields.description: Number of integration steps from nsteps.

fields.label: Van der Waals type
fields.description: Van der Waals method from vdw-type.
